subject: [hw] DONE opus-hevcdec: HEVC frames complete on the host (320x240 12/12, 1080p 6/6, display order ok); facts/HEVC_DEC_PROTOCOL.md
body:
Host only; nothing on the phone, nothing published, no vendor code in the tree, no shared file edited.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevdec_hevc/run_hevc_ref.sh
  -> N2TEST FAKEVDEC-HEVC PASS 30/30 (model unit test, ASan/UBSan)
  -> h320: 12 AUs (B-frames) displayed 0,3,2,1,5,4,8,7,6,11,10,9 = ffprobe; h1080: 6 AUs 0,2,1,5,4,3 = ffprobe
  -> N2TEST HEVCDEC-REF PASS 3/3

Key facts (evidence in facts/HEVC_DEC_PROTOCOL.md):
- HEVC video decode = direct MMIO, no GCE (0 flushes); GCE only behind Vdec_Drv_H265_open arg6 == 0x1c ([I] HEIF).
- LAT+core per frame like H.264 (LOCK_LAT, LOCK_CORE, WAITISR 1 then 0); the LAT parses via LAT HEVC_VLD 0x16015000 -> needs RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL (17.7% of HEVC ops outside the ten windows).
- The '+0xe8 forever' blocker was the LAT init-fetch handshake; then start-code search HEVC_VLD(37) bit8, LAT/core done (HEVC_VLD(36) trigger -> MISC(41) bit16 + IRQ), last-LCU HEVC_VLD(75) == VLD_TOP(26), and a dec1/vdec_ref.c bug (START data[0]/[1] swapped; posted to DEC01/DEC05).
- Phone needs beyond H.264: only page 0x15000 in the VDEC_ALL allow-list (DEC02's list + 0x15000); same power/IRQs; DMA peak 68 MB at 1080p.
Files: gpu/hwcodec/fakevdec_hevc/{n2vdec_hevc_fake.h,n2vdec_hevc_fake.c,vdec_hevc_ref.c,t_fakevdec_hevc.c,run_hevc_ref.sh,v40-gce-vdec-events.patch}, gpu/hwcodec/facts/HEVC_DEC_PROTOCOL.md.
